entities.summary: Drone metal or drone doom is a style of heavy metal that melds the slow tempos and heaviness of doom metal with the long-duration tones of drone music. Drone metal is sometimes associated with post-metal or experimental metal. drone metal is a music genre, created circa 1992. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
